Tagline: Plan the path. Leave no trace.
StandardInfo: Fresh seed. No hints or undo. Counts toward personal best.
PracticeInfo: Use a seed, ask for hints, or undo. Practice scores stay separate.
Observe: Observation · timer starts with the first valid code
ChooseRow: Select an unused code in row {index, number}
ChooseColumn: Select an unused code in column {index, number}
PauseInfo: The matrix is hidden. Your time is safe.
FinishConfirm: End this intrusion and score the uploaded daemons?
AbandonConfirm: Abandon the current intrusion? It will not enter personal bests.
QuitConfirm: Save this intrusion before exiting. Continue it next time.
DiscardConfirm: Unsaved progress will be lost. Exit anyway?
HintUnavailable: No route found within the search budget. Undo or retry.
NoRoute: Full upload is unreachable. Undo or retry.
SaveFailed: Save failed. Progress remains in memory.
DataDamaged: Data cannot be read. Existing files are protected.
RepairConfirm: Preserve the original file as a backup and create new empty data?
EmptyRecords: Your first completed intrusion will appear here.
AudioUnavailable: Audio device unavailable; gameplay is unaffected.
Controls: Arrows: move · Enter / Space: select · Esc: pause · M: mute
TrainingFirst: 01 / Select the marked code in the first row. Observation is unlimited.
TrainingAlternate: 02 / Follow the highlighted column, then row. Never reuse a cell.
TrainingMatch: 03 / Three consecutive codes upload the first daemon.
TrainingOverlap: 04 / Targets share codes. Follow the markers to upload all three.
TrainingDone: Training complete. You are ready to connect.
